notes: All 5 cases match between Java oracle trace and Go test assertions. exists-in-select: exists(subquery) returns false when S1 window empty, true when non-empty. exists-scene-one: where exists filters S0 events when S1 window empty. exists-filtered: correlated exists (s1.id=s0.id) filters by outer event id. two-exists-filtered: two exists conditions must both be satisfied. not-exists: where not exists passes S0 events when S1 window empty. The OM and Compile variants (EPLSubselectExistsInSelectOM, EPLSubselectExistsInSelectCompile, EPLSubselectNotExistsOM, EPLSubselectNotExistsCompile) are SODA/EPL text compilation, which the Go implementation does not support (by design); they are intentionally-different.
